Callout.Name: Breakdown in a Tunnel
Callout.Message: Vehicle stopped inside a tunnel, smoke reported.
Callout.Advisory: Driver out of the vehicle, tunnel filling with fumes.

Script.Line: There is a car stopped inside the tunnel and there is smoke coming off it.
The traffic behind is still coming in. Nobody has shut it off.
Get the tunnel closed. That is the thing that matters.

Lines.Approach: He is out of it and the tunnel is filling up with what is coming off it. Get the traffic stopped.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
